excluded_attested.gold_pickup: Gold-as-item (BH: coins occupy backpack space) -- our game has no shop/gold economy loop; excluded as a non-portable resource verb.
excluded_attested.mana_conductivity: Mana Stone conductive-path powering (BH sec4 P6) -- superseded by our own Unit connectivity mechanic; not re-added as a generic verb to avoid a duplicate system.
excluded_attested.energy_cost: Energy/turn spend to use an item (BH sec5) -- we have no turn-based energy resource; combat is tick-driven, not energy-gated.
excluded_attested.stamina_cost: Stamina cost/regen per attack (BB sec5) -- real-time stamina-gating resource, not part of our tick/BP model.
excluded_attested.shop_reroll: Shop reroll / reserve / sell-for-half (BB/Brawl sec8) -- meta-loop economy verbs, not combat effect verbs; out of scope for the effect vocab.
excluded_attested.recipe_craft: Adjacency-combine crafting into a new item (BB/Brawl sec4 P10, sec7) -- a content/authoring-time transform, not a runtime combat verb; would require a separate crafting-rule system.
excluded_attested.refinery_mod: Paid stat-mod purchase (BH Refinery, sec7) -- gold-gated meta upgrade, not a runtime effect.
excluded_attested.accuracy_crit: Accuracy%/miss and crit-double-damage (BB sec5) -- adds a hit/miss RNG layer our combat model doesn't have; deferred, not part of this vocab.
excluded_attested.charm_status: Charm status (flips enemy to your side, BH sec6) -- PvE-encounter-flipping status with no defined ally-side semantics in our engine; excluded pending a combat-side redesign.

provenance.OnBPBeenHit: research sec6 BH 'When attacked' verb template (Cactus: 'When attacked, Adds 1 Spikes to self')
provenance.multi_strike: research sec5 BH 'Uses per turn... some multi-use (can be used 2 times)'
provenance.buff_adjacent: research sec4 P1 Ruby ('adjacent Weapons get +4 damage') and Amethyst/Emerald row/column beams
provenance.cleanse: research sec7/sec8 BH Healer ('pay 10g to cleanse all curses') and curse-removal economy note in sec10 pitfall 'Curses only work if removal is scarce'
provenance.reflect_damage: research sec6 Spikes status ('attacker takes X on melee hit') and BB Spikes ('reflect 1/stack vs melee')
provenance.lifesteal: research sec6 BB Vampirism ('heal 1/stack on melee hit, same cap') and Bloody Dagger ('heals 4 per adjacent Vampiric item')
provenance.haste: research sec6 BH Haste status ('each block instance gives +X block') and BB Heat ('+2% speed... shift all trigger speeds')
provenance.slow_enemy: research sec6 BH Slow status (paired opposite of Haste, 'each block instance gives -X block')
provenance.bonus_vs_blocked: research sec5 BH Block convention ('Block expires... consumed before HP') combined with BB Spikes cap-vs-hit pattern; a bonus keyed on a defended target is an extrapolated-but-attested combination of block+on_hit verb templates
provenance.Weakness: research sec6 BH 'Rage / Weak: each hit deals +X / -X damage' (paired-opposite status convention)
provenance.Haste_status: research sec6 BH 'Haste / Slow: each block instance gives +X / -X block'
provenance.status_immune: REQ-0093 (2026-07-07): flat immunity to one named vocab.statuses entry, OR to an entire status_kind class, folded at battle_start. Classic archetype fit (bone-and-sinew undead shouldn't suffer Poison; a charging brute can't be Chilled mid-rush). NOTE: this REQ adds status_immune/bonus_vs_status to the vocab independently of REQ-0077 Rev.2's own (uncommitted, as of this REQ) draft of the same two verbs -- see this REQ's file for the discrepancy; the two additions are compatible in shape.
provenance.bonus_vs_status: REQ-0093 (2026-07-07): extends bonus_vs_blocked's precedent (a bonus keyed on the target's condition) to key on an inflicted status -- or an entire status_kind class -- instead of a block event. Lets an attacker punish a target already carrying a matching status.
provenance.status_kinds: REQ-0093 (2026-07-07): closed 9-value keyword vocab exposing BOTH of sim/lib/status.cjs's existing engine-side classifications (polarity: buff/debuff; mechanical: STATUS_KIND's 7 buckets) to status_immune/bonus_vs_status content as a single field choice, so a content author picks exactly one axis-or-name rather than two potentially-conflicting fields. Zero new classification data -- pure reuse of STATUS_KIND/DEBUFF_STATUSES/BUFF_STATUSES, resolved at sim runtime via sim/lib/status.cjs's resolveStatusKind().
provenance.on_hp_below: REQ-0077 Rev.2 (2026-07-07) design rationale, NOT genre-research-sourced: the classic 'enrage below X% HP' RPG monster/boss convention (orc Bloodlust, behemoth Last Stand). A state-crossing condition none of the existing event triggers can express (every_secs/battle_start are time-based; the OnHit/OnSquadHit/OnSquadBeenHit family is hit-reactive, not HP-level-reactive). Fires ONCE EVER per owner+threshold (user ruling 2026-07-12, REQ-0121: no re-arm on healing back above). Trigger param: hp_frac (0<hp_frac<1); fires when hp/hpMax first drops strictly below hp_frac while still alive. Domain ruling (user, 2026-07-09, REQ-0121): [PO, EnemySkill] -- a PO's HP referent is its OWNING BP's hp/hpMax (same object OnBPBeenHit keys off); NOT extended to SI/Unit (no HP concept of their own). NOTE: reopens combat_spec_draft.md's [LOCKED OQ2] 'dynamic buffs = minimal' default for this one case -- user-accepted in REQ-0077's review.
provenance.buff_self: REQ-0077 Rev.2 design rationale: same shape as buff_host (stat:'damage' only, per [LOCKED OQ7]) but targets the owner itself rather than a host PO. Needed because monsters have no host PO to buff (REQ-0078 entity hierarchy: a Monster is a flat actor, no BP/PO/SI/Unit). Used at battle_start (permanent fold at pack compile, sim/lib/packs.cjs) or on_hp_below (fires once; folds onto the owner's own strike/multi_strike ranges at crossing time -- sim/lib/hpbelow.cjs). Implemented by REQ-0121.
provenance.damage_reduction: REQ-0077 Rev.2 design rationale: flat incoming-damage reduction, folded at battle_start (ogre Thick Hide). Applies to DIRECT hit damage (strike/multi_strike primary, splash, reactive strike riders), per sub-hit, floored at zero, AFTER weaknessMultiplier and bonus_vs_status; deliberately does NOT reduce DoT status ticks (Burn/Poison) or Spikes reflect -- a hide blunts blows, not poison. Distinct lifecycle from weaknessMultiplier (status-bag-driven) per REQ-0121's design note: this is a battle_start-folded constant on the actor (ref.damageReduction). Implemented by REQ-0121.
provenance.connection_shapes: REQ-0128 (2026-07-12 user decision: per-unit connection shapes replace always-queen beams; ray types keep the first-hit rule). Registered as a DICTIONARY ONLY on 2026-07-13 by user ruling — implementation deferred to REQ-0128b. adjacency_lr and forward_1 are demanded by the REQ-0149 roster (Watcher, Squire) and are PROVISIONAL. | 2026-07-13: adjacency_lr REMOVED — it was added solely for the Watcher's left/right-adjacent kit, which the user replaced with queen range 2. No def references it; a dangling unused term in a frozen vocabulary is how the clock-tower incident happened. queen_2 added in its place. | 2026-07-13: forward_1 REMOVED (orphaned when the Squire moved to rook range 3) — same hygiene rule that removed adjacency_lr. rook_3 added for the Squire.
provenance.orientation: REQ-0128b (user ruling 2026-07-13): forward = lower Y = up = engine DIRS[0] (N).
provenance.connection_model: REQ-0128b user rulings 2026-07-13: (1) rays do not pierce by default, keep it parameterisable; (2) adjacency = a range-limited ray, not an offset concept; (3) connections are canvas-local (Squad-scoped).
provenance.grant_charge: User ruling 2026-07-14 (REQ-0129): giving charge to a connected Unit is an EFFECT verb, not a spend mode -- the unit fires on full and its effect happens to be grant_charge -> units_connected. With pulse propagation retired, this is the only way a chain is expressed. NOT YET RENDERABLE: no unit validator kind exists, so this verb has no self-test fixture and no engine implementation.
provenance.advance_cooldown: AGENT-DEFINED 2026-07-16 (REQ-0129 impl-log) under the user delegation 「適当に決めておいてください。数値は全て範囲で。(ハスクラ)」 (2026-07-16). Reduces the remaining cooldown of the target's cooldown-bearing item(s) by `n`, a [lo,hi] range that rolls per instance (ハスクラ), so they become ready sooner. Freezes the effect verb the cooldown kits need: Elf & Dwarf (G5, advance a connected BP's item cooldowns -> bp_connected), Watcher (G12, advance the single longest-cooldown item -> bp_connected_max_cooldown_item), Thief (G3a, advance/clear its own items -> self). NOT YET ENGINE-IMPLEMENTED and no unit-context fixture (no `unit` validator kind / no charge AST) -- same status as grant_charge; it renders via eff_render in the generic verb self-test only. THIS IS NOT A USER RULING.
provenance.fire_items: AGENT-DEFINED 2026-07-16 (REQ-0129 impl-log) under the 2026-07-16 delegation. Immediately fires (triggers the effect of) the target's items carrying tag `tag`. Freezes the effect verb Shieldmaiden (fire Armor items -> self) and Light Cavalry (fire Weapon items -> self + bp_connected) need. This goes beyond the clarifying question's named gaps (G5/G12/G13) to the two remaining kits whose charge effect was otherwise inexpressible; flagged in the impl-log and overturnable. NOT YET ENGINE-IMPLEMENTED, no unit-context fixture; renders via eff_render. THIS IS NOT A USER RULING.
provenance.grant_shield: AGENT-DEFINED 2026-07-16 (REQ-0129 impl-log) under the 2026-07-16 delegation. Grants a shield of amount `n`, a [lo,hi] range that rolls per instance; a def may instead scale it as a fraction of the granter's own block (Princess: 'half its own'). ONE verb SHARED by Squire (G13, self a small block -> self) and Princess (connected BP a shield = a fraction of its own -> bp_connected; and the passive damage->self-shield -> self). Decision: Squire and Princess share grant_shield. NOT YET ENGINE-IMPLEMENTED, no unit-context fixture; renders via eff_render. THIS IS NOT A USER RULING.

queen.note: 8-direction rays, unlimited. The pre-pivot Linker default.

queen_2.note: 8-direction rays, range 2. REQ-0149 Watcher (user ruling 2026-07-13: range 1 made connection nearly impossible).

rook_3.note: Orthogonal rays, range 3. REQ-0149 Squire (user ruling 2026-07-13).

lance.note: Forward ray, unlimited. forward = DIRS[0] = N (orientation ruling).

backward_line.note: Backward ray, unlimited. REQ-0149 Shieldmaiden — she is the front line and guards what stands behind her. The mirror of lance (Light Cavalry).

adjacency.note: Rook ray with range 1. Part of the user's ORIGINAL ratified vocabulary (2026-07-12), but NO roster-001 unit uses it — kept because the user ratified it, not because a def needs it.

chess_knight_move.ja: チェス・ナイトの動き
chess_knight_move.note: Chess knight: 8 fixed offsets, jumps. `range` and `pierce` are INVALID on offset shapes (user ruling 2026-07-14). Renamed from `knight` on 2026-07-14: the id named a PIECE and the ja label said 桂, but the offsets were the chess set. Keima and knight are different MOVEMENTS and now carry different ids. These are movement names; they have nothing to do with unit names.

shougi_keima_move.note: Shougi keima: 2 fixed FORWARD offsets, jumps. forward = row-1 = N per the orientation ruling. RESERVED by user ruling 2026-07-14 -- registered as vocabulary; no roster-001 unit uses it and the engine may leave it unimplemented. `range` and `pierce` are INVALID on offset shapes.

orientation.note: User ruling 2026-07-13: 前方 = the battlefield cell with the LOWER Y (i.e. up). Engine convention is [row, col] with row increasing DOWNWARD (engine.js), so forward = row-1 = DIRS[0] = N. This is what `lance`, `backward_line` and `forward_1` mean. Before this ruling those three shapes were undefined and `backward-line` had shipped in the ratified vocabulary carrying the assumption unexamined.

connection_model.shape: {dirs, range, pierce} for ray shapes; {offsets} for offset shapes
connection_model.range: 0 or null = unlimited (reaches the board edge); N = the ray reaches AT MOST N cells. User ruling 2026-07-14. INVALID on offset shapes.
connection_model.occluder_set: UNITS ONLY. A ray without pierce is stopped by the first Unit on it; BP and PO cells are TRANSPARENT and never block a ray. User ruling 2026-07-14 -- this closes the question REQ-0128b left explicitly open ("what occupies a cell for the purpose of stopping a ray -- any BP/PO cell, or only Units?").
connection_model.pierce: false (default) = the ray stops at the first Unit and links it (first-hit). true = the ray is NOT stopped and links EVERY Unit within range. User ruling 2026-07-14. INVALID on offset shapes.
connection_model.scope: canvas-local -- connections resolve within one Squad only (user ruling 2026-07-13).
connection_model.propagation: NONE. Links are a STATIC GRAPH: a Unit does not relay anything it receives. User ruling 2026-07-14 RETIRES the REQ-0048/0061 pulse-walk law set for Unit Links, law by law -- PULSE_CAP, the visited-set, the hop budget and hop latency all have no referent here. Charge is the single flow economy and charge capacity IS the rate limit. A chain is expressible ONLY as `grant_charge` -> units_connected, or as a receiver-side charge trigger (on_connected_unit_*).
connection_model.note: adjacency is NOT a separate concept: it is a ray with range 1 (user ruling 2026-07-13). Every ray shape is {dirs, range, pierce}. Offset shapes jump, so occlusion and range do not apply to them.

charge._doc: Unit charge grammar. FROZEN by user ruling 2026-07-14 (REQ-0129). A unit def carries `charge: {trigger, gain, capacity, spend}`. NOT YET ENFORCED: validateBody has no `unit` kind -- see `_status`.
charge._status: RATIFIED, NOT IMPLEMENTED. No `unit` validator kind and no charge AST exist. The code REQ that adds them must move `charge.triggers` into the top-level `triggers` list, add `trigger_domains` entries, and add self-test fixtures -- the REQ-0081 coverage gate will then hold them honest.
charge._status_v14: v14 (2026-07-16, REQ-0129 impl-log) adds the AGENT-DEFINED charge-EFFECT verbs (advance_cooldown, fire_items, grant_shield) to the top-level `verbs` list -- renderable and self-tested like grant_charge, but NOT engine-implemented and with no unit-context fixture; the max-selector target bp_connected_max_cooldown_item to charge.targets; and the capacity-as-cap semantics for passive_per_stack. Placement honesty is unchanged from v13: charge.triggers stay OUT of the top-level `triggers` list (the REQ-0081 coverage gate demands a fixture and no `unit` validator kind exists). The code REQ that adds the `unit` validator kind and the charge AST implements all of this and moves charge.triggers into `triggers`.

spend.fire_on_full: At capacity, fire `effects` and reset the counter to 0. The classic active skill.
spend.passive_per_stack: Never consumed. A standing effect scales with the accumulated stack count (REQ-0149 Berserker: +0.1% damage per stack). CAP (AGENT-DEFINED 2026-07-16, REQ-0129 impl-log, under the delegation): for passive_per_stack, `capacity` is the STACK CAP -- the maximum number of stacks that can accumulate; trigger firings past it do not raise the effect further. This closes REQ-0149 G6 with no new field and no new spend mode -- `capacity`, already in the charge block, now bounds passive_per_stack. The Berserker's cap is a per-instance range (ハスクラ); the range is in the REQ-0129 settlement table, not here. THIS IS NOT A USER RULING.
spend.transform: At capacity, the unit is replaced by another unit def (form change). REQ-0129 named this as a mandatory expressibility check (REQ-0149 Little Princess -> Princess).

gain.count: +1 per trigger firing (REQ-0149 Angel: the NUMBER OF TIMES damage was taken).
gain.damage: +the damage amount of the triggering event (REQ-0149 Shieldmaiden: the AMOUNT of damage received).

triggers.OnHit: An item on the unit's BP lands a hit. EXISTING trigger, reused. (REQ-0149 Elf)
triggers.OnBPBeenHit: The unit's BP takes damage. EXISTING trigger, reused. (REQ-0149 Dwarf / Angel / Shieldmaiden / Berserker -- they differ in `gain`, not in trigger)
triggers.every_secs: Elapsed time / cooldown. EXISTING trigger, reused. (REQ-0149 Watcher)
triggers.on_damage_dealt: AGENT-DEFINED 2026-07-14 under the user's trigger delegation. Damage dealt by the unit's BP. (REQ-0149 Light Cavalry)
triggers.on_connected_unit_spend: AGENT-DEFINED 2026-07-14. A Unit at the other end of a link spends its charge. (REQ-0149 Thief -- this is the charge source the G3a ruling named)
triggers.on_connected_unit_attack: AGENT-DEFINED 2026-07-14. A connected Unit performs an attack. (REQ-0149 Squire)
triggers.on_connected_unit_bp_been_hit: AGENT-DEFINED 2026-07-14. A connected Unit's BP takes damage. (REQ-0149 Priest / Princess)
triggers.on_own_passive_fire: AGENT-DEFINED 2026-07-14. The unit's own passive fires. (REQ-0149 Little Princess -- capacity is still the unspecified 'XX', G2 OPEN)

charge.triggers_growth: DELEGATED to the agent by user ruling 2026-07-14 (verbatim: 「targetと同じく私に委任」). New charge-source triggers may be added WITHOUT a design event. Every agent-added trigger MUST be labelled AGENT-DEFINED, so that a machine's choice is never mistaken for a user ruling.

targets.units_connected: Every Unit this Unit links to. USER-RATIFIED 2026-07-14; the name is the one the user chose.
targets.bp_connected: The BP a connected Unit sits on. AGENT-DEFINED 2026-07-14 under the delegation below. Required by REQ-0149 Angel / Dwarf / Princess / Light Cavalry / Watcher. THIS IS NOT A USER RULING.
targets.units_connected_distributed: The effect amount is divided across the connected Units. AGENT-DEFINED 2026-07-14 under the same delegation. Required by REQ-0149 Priest ('distributed if there are several'). THIS IS NOT A USER RULING.
targets.bp_connected_max_cooldown_item: AGENT-DEFINED 2026-07-16 under the targets delegation (targets_growth, user 2026-07-14 「後は、私に聞かないで、必要になったらあなたが定義してください」). The single cooldown-bearing item with the LONGEST remaining cooldown on a connected Unit's BP -- a max-selector that resolves `bp_connected` down to one item. Required by REQ-0149 Watcher (G12), whose charge effect advances that item's cooldown. THIS IS NOT A USER RULING.

charge.targets_growth: DELEGATED to the agent by user ruling 2026-07-14 (verbatim: 「後は、私に聞かないで、必要になったらあなたが定義してください」). New charge targets may be added WITHOUT a design event, under the same AGENT-DEFINED labelling rule.
charge.effects_note: Charge EFFECTS are ordinary `verbs` from the top-level list. The user ruling of 2026-07-14 draws the line: `spend` is WHEN/HOW the counter is consumed; `verbs` is WHAT then happens. Giving charge away is therefore an effect verb (`grant_charge`), NOT a fourth spend mode.

effect_verbs._doc: AGENT-DEFINED charge-effect verbs frozen 2026-07-16 (REQ-0129 impl-log) under the delegation 「適当に決めておいてください。数値は全て範囲で。(ハスクラ)」. They live in the top-level `verbs` list (renderable, self-tested) like grant_charge; they are NOT YET engine-implemented (no `unit` validator kind / no charge AST). Numbers are per-instance ranges (ハスクラ); the specific ranges are in the REQ-0129 settlement table, not here (vocab is grammar, not content).
effect_verbs.reused_from_v13: cleanse (Angel), heal_bp (Priest -> units_connected_distributed), buff_self (Berserker, passive_per_stack), transform-spend (Little Princess).

deprecated.on_link_pulse: DEPRECATED 2026-07-14 (user ruling, REQ-0128b): Unit Links have NO propagation, so there is no pulse to fire on. STILL SHIPPED: exercised by tools/self_test_vocab.cjs:151 and content/s4_boards/s4_fixture_items.json. Removing it must remove those too and re-baseline the S4 sim gate (REQ-0050). NOT done here.
deprecated.pulse: DEPRECATED 2026-07-14 (user ruling, REQ-0128b): same. STILL SHIPPED: content/s4_boards/s4_fixture_items.json. Same removal conditions.
deprecated.buff_linked: DEPRECATED 2026-07-14: Linker-era verb. The charge grammar expresses this as an ordinary verb aimed at `units_connected`. Kept because removing a verb is a code change with a coverage gate attached.
deprecated.REQ-0061 8-type connective axis: RETIRED 2026-07-14 (user ruling, 供養): delay / divider / junction / toggle / terminal / amplifier / splitter / condenser were each a definition of what a Unit does to a PULSE PASSING THROUGH IT. With propagation retired they have no referent. They are NOT re-derived as charge verbs. Never shipped -- nothing to remove.
